newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Bryant pleads guilty to one Port Arthur killing.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Bryant pleads guilty to one Port Arthur killing.

text.p: The man accused of the worst mass killing in modern Australian history confessed to one of the 35 murders, reversing his earlier plea of not guilty, in the Supreme Court of Tasmania on Thursday.
Martin Bryant, 29, who pleaded not guilty in September to the killings in the southern island state of Tasmania in April, is due to go to trial on November 19.
On April 28, a gunman opened fire on tourists at the historic Port Arthur convict site on Tasmania's southeast coast, killing 35 people. Bryant was arrested the following morning.
Bryant on Thursday pleaded guilty to killing David Martin, who was shot dead in a guesthouse which was burnt down during the shooting spree.
Bryant was arrested leaving the burning guesthouse.
Bryant appeared in court under heavy police protection, with the bomb squad sweeping the court building before his appearance.
